message.content:
Using the sum identity
\[
\sum_{k=1}^n \sin(k\theta)=\frac{\sin(n\theta/2)\sin((n+1)\theta/2)}{\sin(\theta/2)},
\]
set \(n=35\) and \(\theta=5^\circ\). Then
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{35}\sin(5k)^\circ
=
\frac{\sin\left(\frac{35\cdot 5}{2}\right)^\circ \sin\left(\frac{36\cdot 5}{2}\right)^\circ}{\sin\left(\frac52\right)^\circ}.
\]
So
\[
S=\frac{\sin(87.5^\circ)\sin(90^\circ)}{\sin(2.5^\circ)}
=\frac{\sin(87.5^\circ)}{\sin(2.5^\circ)}
=\frac{\cos(2.5^\circ)}{\sin(2.5^\circ)}
=\cot(2.5^\circ).
\]
Thus
\[
\tan r^\circ=\cot(2.5^\circ)=\tan(87.5^\circ).
\]
The tangent function has period \(180^\circ\), so
\[
r=87.5+180m,\qquad m\in\mathbb Z.
\]
The smallest positive rational value occurs at \(m=0\), giving
\[
r=87.5=\frac{175}{2}.
\]

The answer is \(\frac{175}{2}\).
